text:
Peverell Semiconductors will lay off 1,200 staff, the company announced on 14 March 2025, cutting about 18% of its 6,700-person global workforce.

Chief Executive Officer Marguerite Oyelaran-Finch confirmed the cuts on an investor call held the same day. Peverell set out the restructuring in a Form 8-K filing submitted on 14 March.

"These decisions are never easy, and we do not take them lightly," Oyelaran-Finch said. "We are acting to put the company on a sustainable footing."

The filing and the call form the basis of this report. The job losses represent nearly one in five of the company's employees worldwide.

The Harbour Dispatch will report further details as they become available.
